questions.question: The paradox of Alankara and Svabhavokti in Indian Poetics
questions.solution_html:
• Alankara (embellishment) – main source of poetic beauty – it separated poetic language from
  • ordinary language – Svabavokti (natural description) - if alankara was absolutely necessary
  • for poetry, then svabhavokti could not be accepted as poetry because it referred to expression
  • without embellishment – the relationship between embellishment and the thing embellished
  • existed naturally in alankara - svabavokti was unembellished expression (Kuntaka) – poems
  • containing only svabavokti without any figure of speech are also beautiful – opinions are
  • divided – some critics rejected. In contrast, others accepted it in some forms.
questions.final_answer: divided – some critics rejected. In contrast, others accepted it in some forms
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: What are the major characteristics that distinguish English Romanticism / from other literary periods?
questions.solution_html:
• Supported French Revolution – cultural and revolutionary ideas are revolutionary – Blake –
  • first major Romantic poet – mystical and myth based - criticized emerging urban and
  • industrial society – highlighted social injustice and attacked dominance of rational thinking –
  • Wordsworth – nature and spirit – simple language and rustic life - Coleridge – power of
  • imagination – primary and secondary – suspension of disbelief - Shelley – imagination over
  • reason – elevated poetry’s importance – Keats – negative capability.
questions.final_answer: reason – elevated poetry’s importance – Keats – negative capability
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Discuss John Crowe Ransom's major principles of New Criticism and / his emphasis on the close study of the literary work.
questions.solution_html:
• Criticism is rigorous- precise and scientific – focus on the text itself not historical
  • background, biography or moral content – poetry is ontologically unique – can’t be reduced to
  • prose or paraphrase – literature and criticism should be autonomous disciplines.
questions.final_answer: prose or paraphrase – literature and criticism should be autonomous disciplines
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026

questions.question: Examine the evolution of Sanskrit literary theory from the early theorists / to the later tradition.
questions.solution_html:
• Earliest Bharata – Natyasastra – Rasa theory – Bhamaha – Kavyalankara – alankarika –
  • Dandin – Kavyadarsa – discussed poetic qualities necessary in literature – Udbhata –
  • figurative language in poetry – Anandhavardhana – Dhvanyaloka – theory of dhvani –
  • Abhinavagupta – renaissance man – Kuntaka – Vakroktijivita – Ksemendra –
  • Aucityavicaracarca- importance of propriety in literature – Mahimabhatta – Vyaktiviveka –
  • supported theory of anumana or inference – Bhoja – Sringaraprakasa – Mammata –
  • Kavyaprakasa – Jagannatha – the emperor of poets – pandita raja – Rasagangadhara – last
  • major theoretician.
questions.final_answer: major theoretician
questions.source_exam: V Semester MGU UGP (Honours) - 2024 Admission regular Examination October 2026
